items.title: Deadline to file Einspruch against interest assessment
items.quote: Sie können gegen diese Festsetzung innerhalb eines Monats Einspruch beim Finanzamt Beispielsoest erheben.
items.computation: Letter dated 19.11.2026 (Thursday); this is presumed the day of posting (Aufgabe zur Post). The letter states Bekanntgabe occurs on the 4th day after posting (current §122 Abs. 2 AO rule, extended to 4 days since the 2025 postal law reform). Counting: 19.11. +1=Fri 20.11, +2=Sat 21.11, +3=Sun 22.11, +4=Mon 23.11.2026 -> Bekanntgabe = 23.11.2026 (a weekday, no weekend/holiday shift needed). The one-month Einspruch period begins the following day (§108 AO i.V.m. §187 Abs. 1 BGB), i.e. 24.11.2026, and ends one month later on the day with the same number per §188 Abs. 2 BGB: 23.12.2026. 23.12.2026 is a Wednesday and not a public holiday in NRW, so no extension under §108 Abs. 3 AO applies.
